title: Return-to-state execution contract
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine, let $a$ be an anchor state, let $I$ be a type of data, and fix an input string $x$. A return contract assigns each data value and configuration a precondition, a strictly positive running time, an endpoint, and integer lower and upper bounds for each work-tape head. Whenever a configuration starts in state $a$ and satisfies the precondition, the run reaches its assigned endpoint at the assigned time, and that endpoint is again in state $a$; at each positive time strictly before the endpoint, the state is not $a$, and throughout the run each work-tape head stays within its assigned bounds.
